request.name: Field / headphone concept
request.prompt: A single pair of premium matte graphite wireless over-ear headphones standing upright on a low circular warm ivory plinth, balanced arching headband and two symmetrical ear cups, subtle lime accent at the earcup rim, dark forest-green seamless studio background, warm soft key light from camera left and a thin rim light from behind. Realistic product photography, simple clean silhouette, no text, no logos, no people.
